clusters.canonical_name: Support resident daily care and health routines
clusters.objective: Maintain the resident's recurring daily care routines (morning activity lighting, low-light illumination, and reminders for cognitive training, eye drops, and hydration) through negotiated automation.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: implicit-to-explicit; resident-caregiver negotiated deployment authorizing lighting control and periodic reminders
clusters.rationale: Both coders rate the unit strongly_implies with identifiable beneficiary, recurring temporal scope, accepted automation delegation, and a care_lapse failure objective in a negotiated deployment; this is the narrowest compound claim the single unit supports because the rules are jointly negotiated as one care-routine program.
clusters.boundary_notes: Illumination and reminder facets are kept together because the evidence presents them as one negotiated care program; not merged with hypothetical lighting-comfort (userneeds_u25_r146) or fitness-goal (userneeds_u07_r038) evidence, which have different outcomes and weaker standing.

clusters.canonical_name: Guard home access and perimeter security
clusters.objective: Maintain household security by monitoring door visitors when the family is away, ensuring nighttime closure of blinds/windows/doors, and responding to failed alarm-code entries.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit; authorized actions limited to monitoring, notification, closure/locking, and alarm
clusters.rationale: Four independent demand owners within one study cluster converge on the same maintained outcome (home access/perimeter security) with security_failure meaning and explicit action authorization, but all evidence is hypothetical, no unit is rated strongly_implies, and no cross-study confirmation exists.
clusters.boundary_notes: Delivery-gate opening (userneeds_u16_r096) is excluded as a convenience/access-for-expected-delivery objective with unknown failure meaning, not merged here. All evidence is participant-authored hypothetical and not deployed.

clusters.canonical_name: Keep floors and home clean while unoccupied
clusters.objective: Maintain routine household cleanliness by running cleaning chores (robot floor cleaning, laundry) on a recurring schedule while the home is unoccupied.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit; authorized actions limited to starting cleaning/laundry appliances
clusters.rationale: Three independent demand owners across two study clusters express the same maintained outcome (scheduled cleaning while away) with recurring scope, accepted automation delegation, and explicit action authorization; failure meaning is supported only weakly as inconvenience, so confidence is low.
clusters.boundary_notes: Laundry (userneeds_u07_r041) is retained only as part of the cleaning-while-away program; standalone laundry upkeep is not separately supported. All units are hypothetical desired behaviors; none establish deployment or failure experience.
coding_disagreements: userneeds_u07_r041 temporal_scope: luna=event_conditioned, kimi=recurring; failure_meaning: luna=unknown, kimi=none
